summary: The week opened with fallout from Vale's Aug 1 blow-up over a chatter falsely telling a fan that a girl-girl video featured her best friend Shayna; Ollie investigated, apologized, and briefed the chatter on Aug 2, and Vale flagged that the girl-girl videos should not be in her vault at all. The rest of the week was busy and mostly cooperative: she delivered a new sexting set (plus a missing video Ollie caught), uploaded wall pics and selfies, paid her invoice within days, and even referred another creator for management. Friction remains around video call scheduling, which has dragged for months and produced confusion again this week (Ryan/John mix-ups, Ryan rescheduling twice, and an unanswered request for fan notes before her Aug 8 call). Mood: engaged and loyal, but her trust in the chat team's honesty with fans is being tested.

Avoiding chargebacks and account/vault hygiene after the agency-switch content losses
suggestions: Run a full vault audit with Vale this week: purge the unauthorized girl-girl videos and pre-nose-job content she flagged, and confirm the purge back to her in writing

Create a single video-call tracker (fan, amount paid, status, scheduled date) shared in the OnlyFans topic so she stops having to ask what's booked — the Ryan/John confusion on Aug 3 and 'Was a call booked for today ?' on Aug 7 were both avoidable
Always send fan prep notes proactively before her calls/lives (Fred used to do this); her Aug 7 request for notes on the Aug 8 11am OF call went unanswered in-chat

Acknowledge and fast-track her referral (girl interested in management, Aug 3) — referrals from a happy client are worth protecting
